body: In `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs:78-87`, `:536-539`, `:643-657`, and `:702-716`, new juveniles/sub-adults/adults are added by bumping `count` (and sometimes `reserve_g`) only. The destination cohort's `condition_index` and `maturation_accum` are never reset or blended with the incoming animals, even though `update_condition()` already ran earlier in the day. If a stage previously emptied with stale condition or fractional maturation progress, later recruits inherit that extinct cohort state and can be blocked or promoted immediately on the same tick. Reinitialize or count-weight these fields whenever a stage receives entrants, and add a regression test for hatch/promote-after-empty cases.
